column3: The approval preview redacts the argument values with the kernel's redactValue (exposed as secrets.redactValue, replacing secrets.redact) before canonical() serializes them, then caps at 500
column4: XIN-23 review of #118 at 2e2d3570: redacting the canonical JSON string missed a secret holding a quote or backslash, since JSON escaping changes its text. redactValue is redaction.ts's existing value walker, so there is still one implementation and rows still never read a value
column5: plugins/policy/policy.test.ts: a secret holding a quote and a backslash appears in neither request.list nor xin.requests, raw or escaped once or twice; four mutations (owner check, child-removal merge, take() arguments match, redaction) each fail a test
